lines.text: Jesus warns His disciples to beware of the leaven of the Sadducees, which is hypocrisy.
Jesus says what is hidden will be made known, and whispers in inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.
Jesus says do not fear those who kill the body, but fear the One who can throw you into hell.
Jesus says five sparrows are sold for two pennies, and the hairs of your head are all numbered.
Jesus says words against the Son of Man will be forgiven, and the Father will teach them what to say.
